cards.title: Malacca, 1400
cards.description: A prince rests by the river under a Melaka tree. A mouse-deer kicks his hunting dog into the water — an omen, the prince decides. He'll build a kingdom here.
cards.image_prompt: Peaceful 15th-century Malacca riverbank scene, a young prince in traditional robes resting under a fruit tree, a mouse-deer kicking a hunting dog into shallow water, jungle canopy, warm golden hour lighting, isometric digital illustration

cards.title: The Land is Named.
cards.description: The prince points to the tree and speaks the name aloud. It sticks. The kingdom will be called Melaka — after the fruit that shaded him at the moment his mind was made up.

cards.title: The Kingdom is Founded.
cards.description: Trade routes secured. Alliances forged. The kingdom thrives. The riverbank blurs. The portal to 1957 opens — the next pivotal moment in Malaysia's story awaits.

cards.title: Merdeka Square, 1957
cards.description: A sea of white songkok and headscarves. A wooden podium. Above it, a flag pole waits. Rumors fly through the crowd — some right, most wrong. Verify the facts, then set the date.
cards.image_prompt: 1957 Merdeka Square Kuala Lumpur, huge crowd in traditional Malay attire, wooden podium with microphone, Malaysian flag rising against clear sky, celebratory but historic atmosphere, isometric digital illustration

cards.title: Facts Verified.
cards.description: The false claims are stripped off the podium. Only truth remains. The crowd steadies. Now — set the date.

cards.title: Merdeka! Merdeka! Merdeka!
cards.description: Every dial clicks into place. Tunku Abdul Rahman raises his hand. 'MERDEKA!' — seven times, the crowd roars back. The flag rises. The portal ripples forward — 67 years later, in a land the prince could never have imagined, the cloud arrives.

cards.title: AWS Malaysia, 2024
cards.description: A crisp data center in Cyberjaya. Fans hum. Blue LEDs pulse. Somewhere on a shelf sits a piñata scrap, still glittering. Two consoles wait: one asks about the newest region, one asks where the cloud began.
cards.image_prompt: Modern AWS data center interior in Cyberjaya Malaysia, sleek server racks with blue LED strips, ceremonial pinata scraps on a table, two glowing consoles in the foreground, celebratory but professional atmosphere, isometric digital illustration

cards.title: Malaysia Region: Live.
cards.description: Four answers, four green ticks. ap-southeast-5 lights up on the wall map. A cheer goes up somewhere in Cyberjaya. Now — where did this all begin?

cards.title: Welcome to the Cloud.
cards.description: 2006. The terminal glows green. From a tree in 1400 to a shout in 1957 to a region in 2024 — you've traveled from a kingdom under a tree to a region in the cloud. Malaysia Boleh! 🇲🇾
